title: A finite-type quasi-separated algebraic stack embeds closed into a finitely presented stack over a qcqs base

standard_prerequisites.use: Algebraic stacks and smooth groupoid presentations, finite-typeqcqs approximation of algebraic spaces, finite-presentation descent of morphisms and diagrams, quotient stacks and local criteria for closed immersions.

core_obligations: Approximate a smooth groupoid presentation together with its composition, identity, inverse and fibre-product diagrams at one finite stage.
Ensure the groupoid relations and smoothness hold at that stage, form the quotient stack, and prove the original stack maps into its base change as a closed substack.

proof_roadmap.step: Approximate a smooth groupoid presentation together with its composition, identity, inverse and fibre-product diagrams at one finite stage.
Ensure the groupoid relations and smoothness hold at that stage, form the quotient stack, and prove the original stack maps into its base change as a closed substack.

difficulty_reason: Approximating the objects alone is insufficient: all structure maps and groupoid equations must descend compatibly and give the desired closed immersion after taking quotients. This synchronized construction supplies H2 work.
